title: Choose the visual world for YAT.lifestyle
question: Which world should shape the homepage, identity system, and dropper-led hero?

options.label: Afterimage Hong Kong
options.lineage: Hong Kong cinema film leaders, contact sheets, subtitle cards, and projection light
options.thesis: Each fragrance is a frame where time, place, and personal chemistry develop into scent.
options.viewport: A monumental dropper suspends a Hong Kong afterimage inside one droplet while a contact sheet previews time, place, and laboratory ritual.
options.risk: Film nostalgia must not overpower fragrance clarity or turn Hong Kong into a cinematic cliché.

options.label: Scent Line Map
options.lineage: Metropolitan rail diagrams and Hong Kong wayfinding discipline
options.thesis: The three fragrance lines become routes converging at one dropper-shaped interchange.
options.viewport: A city-scale scent network traces time, Hong Kong memory, and Element toward one central droplet.
options.case: Immediately Hong Kong and easy to navigate, but risks making perfume feel like public transport rather than desire.
options.risk: It must avoid copying MTR trade dress or reducing the brand to a map gimmick.

options.label: Time Signal
options.lineage: Seven-segment clocks, scoreboards, and instrument displays
options.thesis: A fixed time display ignites into a droplet, making each hour a fragrance state.
options.viewport: A giant 06:00 readout changes state around a suspended amber droplet.
options.case: Makes the Time collection unforgettable, but identifies weakly with Hong Kong and leaves Element secondary.
options.risk: The clock can become the brand instead of supporting the complete fragrance house.

options.label: Element Stack
options.lineage: Cathode numeral stacks, bronze instrument gauze, and laboratory readouts
options.thesis: Every possible scent state remains visible while the customer's Element is struck into focus.
options.viewport: A laboratory dropper floats above layered ghost states with Element illuminated as the active result.
options.case: Explains scientific personalization clearly, but has the weakest Hong Kong identification of the viable directions.
options.risk: Too much instrument language would make the brand feel technical rather than sensorial.

canonCard.label: Quiet Luxury Atelier
canonCard.lineage: The conventional luxury perfume editorial site
canonCard.thesis: An ivory gallery, centered vessel, black serif wordmark, and restrained gold details.
canonCard.viewport: A centered fragrance vessel and generous editorial headline lead to a coming-soon action.
canonCard.risk: It is clear and polished but could belong to almost any premium fragrance brand.
